profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Java Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Software Development, Computer Science, Java, REST/SOAP, SCRUM, and English. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor in Computer Technology focused in Computer Science from Tecnológico de Monterrey.

positions.title: Commissioning Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop, test, install, and support custom built systems for warehouse management and automation for sites generally located the US.

positions.description: Worked helping with costumer aid, and back storage management.

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped develop children's social awareness and through activities help them motivate to start the path to achieve their future goals; became and agent of change for children in a high risk environment.

Taught a group of middle school children, and helped develop their sense of creativity and problem solving skills though series of activities in preparation for a creative problem-solving competition called Odyssey of the Mind.

projects.title: DOW- Solar Evaporator
projects.description: Sphere of Innovation member. Multidisciplinary project developing an innovating solution/design to accelerate the natural evaporation process, using low cost, low maintenance materials.
